text:
Jared (CSM): FYI - PolarisHealth asked for formal SLO language and an example credits table ahead of their renewal review next Monday. They want 99.95% uptime, p95 < 220ms, and a clear latency-credit mechanism.
Sam (AE): Which plan are they on? Hosted standard or Dedicated?
Jared (CSM): Hosted standard. Traffic ~1.3M tokens/day, global but heavy on eu-west.
Priya (Onboarding): Current telemetry shows p95 ~210ms after we enabled adaptive batching. Still seeing occasional spikes during batch jobs. I can put together a 14-day trend for eu-west and a histogram.
Hannah (SRE): Quick reality check: our baseline for that cluster is ~190ms p95. For credits, we usually only do uptime credits in the T&Cs. Latency credit is negotiable as an addendum but needs a clear trigger and cap.
Jared (CSM): Polaris is pushing for latency credits tied to p95 breaches, and weekly transparency reports for 90 days post-renewal. Can we commit to weekly PDFs for 90 days?
Priya (Onboarding): 90 days weekly is heavy but doable if we automate the report export and template. I can own the deck generation; just need the fields they want.
Hannah (SRE): Proposed addendum wording (draft): "Latency SLO: p95 < 220ms measured at the customer-tenant ingress point across the calendar month. If monthly p95 > 300ms, Redwood will issue a credit of 3% of the monthly invoice for each 25ms increment above 300ms, capped at 15% per month."
Hannah (SRE): Example table to include in addendum:
```
month_p95_ms = 340
threshold = 300
excess = max(0, month_p95_ms - threshold)  # 40ms
steps = math.ceil(excess / 25)  # 2 steps
credit_pct = min(steps * 3, 15)  # 6% credit
```
Sam (AE): That seems reasonable. Polaris asked for both monthly and weekly breakdowns in the first 90 days. They also asked how sample traces will be redacted.
Jared (CSM): We'll provide 3 anonymized traces per week. Priya, can you include redaction notes and a checklist to ensure PHI is removed?
Priya (Onboarding): Yes, I'll add a redaction checklist and automate masking for trace IDs and payloads.
report-bot: uploaded polaris-eu-west-14d-slo.csv to #shared-reports (link: https://files.redwood/polaris-eu-west-14d-slo.csv)
Jared (CSM): Action items: Hannah to finalize addendum language + sample credit table; Priya to script weekly deck + redaction checklist; Sam to confirm commercial acceptance with Polaris; Jared to consolidate and send draft to legal for review by Thursday. I'll follow up EOD tomorrow with initial timeline. :eyes:
